notes.title: v.1.0.1 available now
notes.content:
v.1.0.1 patch notes


 A little more zoom

You can now zoom out a little further


 Vsync should be on by default



 Added some keyboard input

Q/E or PageUP/PageDOWN zooms
WASD or numeric 8/4/6/2 moved the cursor
SPACE or numeric 0 (hold) draws
NOTE: keyboard input does not work on menus at this time, sorry


 Original music switch

Press SHIFT-M on your keyboard to toggle
Change the game's music to the original Piczle Lines DX soundtrack.
Enjoy the music critics called "grating", "annoying" and "so bad you need to turn it off immediately!"
